title: Duchess Satine Kryze
description: Duchess Satine Kryze was the leader of Mandalore and ushered in an era of peace for the once-warlike people. With the Clone Wars raging throughout the galaxy, she hoped to keep the violence away from her planet and in their past, but violence came to them. The splinter group Death Watch—led by Pre Vizsla— allied with Maul and joined his Shadow Collective to overthrow Satine and her government. Though her former love, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and sister, Bo-Katan, rescued her, Maul would still eventually cut her down.
